description: Sequence-level evaluation split for the estimator-aware VLM SLAM project. Six sequences have camera ground truth and form the localization benchmark. Two D455 sequences have no independent ground truth and are restricted to perception-level evaluation.
constraints: Splits are at the sequence level. Never split frames from the same sequence across partitions.
Held-out sequences must NOT be used for hyperparameter tuning or model selection.
D455 sequences must NOT be used for ATE/RPE reporting without independent ground truth.
With only 6 ground-truth sequences, population-wide statistical significance claims are limited.
Report per-sequence results individually. Do not pool sequences as independent samples.

development.purpose: Hyperparameter tuning, qualitative debugging, policy development.
development.rationale: Covers lab interior (TUM) and building crowd (Bonn) domains. Both have clear walking persons. Use freely for iteration.

validation.purpose: Early stopping, ablation monitoring, intermediate metric reporting.
validation.rationale: tum_static adds static-background variant of TUM. OpenLORIS adds service-robot corridor domain with long translation.

held_out.purpose: Final paper numbers. Do NOT examine until all design decisions are frozen.
held_out.rationale: tum_halfsphere adds rotational camera motion challenge. bonn_box adds deliberate box obstruction — the hardest sequence. These sequences must not influence any design decisions.

perception_only.purpose: VLM evaluation, track annotation validation, object-level perception experiments.
perception_only.rationale: Custom D455 recordings. No independent camera ground truth. Cannot be used for ATE/RPE. Valid for VLM accuracy and perception quality metrics.

bonn_crowd.gt_source: Bonn RGB-D motion capture ground truth (provided with dataset)

bonn_box.gt_source: Bonn RGB-D motion capture ground truth (provided with dataset)

d455_01.gt_source: NONE — no independent camera ground truth exists for D455 custom recordings

d455_02.gt_source: NONE — no independent camera ground truth exists for D455 custom recordings
